def FusionLogSchedule.CompatibleForLog.{u_1} : {n : ℕ} →
  [inst : NeZero n] →
    {α : Type u_1} →
      [DecidableEq α] →
        (initial : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Placement n (Finset α)) →
          (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites initial).Nonempty →
            List (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.FusionRecord α) →
              RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Placement n (Finset α) → Prop :=
fun {n} [NeZero n] {α} [DecidableEq α] initial nonempty events target =>
  ∃ indexTarget,
    FusionLogSchedule.IndexCompatible (FusionLogSchedule.finalPackets initial nonempty events) indexTarget ∧
      FusionLogInterpretation.expandPlacement (FusionLogInterpretation.siteLabels initial) indexTarget = target
